meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Guides a refactor, cleanup, or restructure with the right decomposition. Use when the user asks to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将混乱代码改造成清晰结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 代码越来越乱,想在不改功能的前提下变得清晰好维护。
copy.tagline_en: Restructure messy code into a clear, maintainable design.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase is messy and you want to clean it up without changing behavior.

howto.what: 收到重构请求后，它会先确认目标和疑点；目标清楚后再探查相关代码与依赖，评估测试覆盖并制定分步计划。它每改一步都会跑诊断、测试与类型检查，最后做全量回归验证并总结改动。
howto.when: 当你说“重构”“简化”“提取”等关键词，或要求让代码更现代化时触发；如果目标、范围或预期结果不清楚，它会先反问确认。

say.text: 请重构 src/auth/handler.ts，范围 file，策略 safe
say.note: 它会先分析依赖和测试，再分步改动并验证。

say.text: 把校验逻辑提取成独立模块，按 module 范围处理
say.note: 会先扫描相关代码并给出重构计划。

say.text: 清理所有用到已废弃 API 的代码，范围 project
say.note: 执行前会先检查测试覆盖并确认受影响范围。

howto.what_en: Given a refactor request, Claude clarifies the goal and scope, maps code/deps, checks test coverage, plans steps, then refactors stepwise while verifying diagnostics and tests after each step. It ends with full tests plus a summary.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude is asked to refactor, simplify, extract or modernize code. If target, scope, or expected outcome is unclear, it first asks clarifying questions.

say_en.text: Refactor src/auth/handler.ts with file scope and safe strategy.
say_en.note: It analyzes deps and tests, then refactors step by step.

say_en.text: Extract the validation logic into a separate module at module scope.
say_en.note: It scans relevant code and suggests a plan first.

say_en.text: Clean up all uses of deprecated APIs at project scope.
say_en.note: It checks test coverage and impact before executing.
